comment: C-first v11 mission for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_CREATE_MONSTER). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of create monster, selects the wished item through the explicit item menu, then answers create_critters' debug-mode type prompt with `*` to choose a random monster. Retain only if C reaches the creation/discovery branch. Closest earlier monster case is v10 bugle-awakens-hostile-soldier: that wakes an already-present hostile, while this branch creates monsters through zapnodir/create_critters.
